entities.name: Mattak
entities.description: A disciplined human hunter in Yasova Dragonclaw's party on Tarkir.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane two generations after the Khanfall.

entities.name: Grandmother
entities.description: Member who decided to harvest valuable organs from the fallen dragon.

entities.name: Tae Jin

entities.name: Ojutai

events.summary: Mattak, on sentry duty, spotted the approaching Atarka broodling and warned the group.
events.quote: He was on sentry duty when he spotted the approaching dragon

events.summary: Yasova sheltered the group in the rocks from a dragon tempest, with Mattak on sentry duty.
events.quote: Mattak was assigned to sentry duty around the concealed entrance to the rock chamber

events.summary: Grandmother harvested organs from the fallen dragon while Mattak stayed to guard Tae Jin.
events.quote: He was among those who stayed behind to guard Tae Jin

relations.quote: Mattak was a human member of Yasova Dragonclaw 's hunting party
